subject: [PATCH 5/6] Documentation: describe atomic whole-device hotplug in daxctl man pages

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch updates the documentation of daxctl commands to describe atomic whole-device hotplug functionality. Specifically, it explains how online-memory and offline-memory use the daxX.Y/state attribute where available, and how offlining a device removes its memory blocks in one operation. The 'hotplug_state' attribute is also documented. This patch aims to improve user understanding of daxctl commands and their behavior with atomic whole-device hotplug support.

reviews.author: Alison Schofield
reviews.summary: Requested that hotplug_state be included in sample outputs for daxctl-list.txt and cxl-list.txt.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, Oct 16, 2026 at 05:42:47PM -0400, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> From: Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net>
> 
> Document that online-memory and offline-memory use daxX.Y/state where
> available, that offlining always removes the memory blocks and how
> that affects reconfigure-device, and the 'hotplug_state' attribute of
> 'daxctl list'.

Hi Greg,

Can you add hotplug_state to sample outputs in daxctl-list.txt and
cxl-list.txt?

-- Alison
